text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "On MD-17 (original and revised), NequIP is compared with invariant GNN-IPs (SchNet and DimeNet), shallow neural networks (ANI), and kernel-based approaches (GAP, FCHL19/GPR, sGDML) [W4225405705#010]. It is also compared with ACE, SpookyNet, GemNet, and other equivariant networks (PaiNN, NewtonNet, UNiTE) [W4225405705#010]. The paper reports that NequIP outperforms all of these methods [W4225405705#011]."}
